function.name: end_session
function.description: Close the conversation. Call when the task is complete rather than waiting for silence.

function.name: forget
function.description: Forget something you remember about the person you are speaking with, so it is never recalled again. Name it by the id shown beside it in what you remember.

memory_id.description: The id of the memory to forget, e.g. m_3f9c2a10.

function.name: ha_call_service
function.description: Act on the home through a Home Assistant service: lights, switches, covers, media players, scripts. Target an entity_id from ha_find_entities, or an area_id. Returns the entities whose state changed; an empty list means nothing matched or nothing needed to change. Some calls need the person's yes: they return confirmation_required with a nonce. Ask them, and once they agree, call again with the same arguments and confirmation set to the nonce.

area_id.description: Area to act on, e.g. kitchen. Required unless entity_id is given.

confirmation.description: The nonce from a confirmation_required result, once the person has said yes. Omit it otherwise.

domain.description: Service domain, e.g. light, switch, script.

entity_id.description: Entity to act on, e.g. light.kitchen. Required unless area_id is given.

service.description: Service within the domain, e.g. turn_on, turn_off, toggle.

function.name: ha_find_entities
function.description: Find Home Assistant entities by domain and name. Call this first when you do not know an entity_id; never guess one.

domain.description: Only entities in this domain, e.g. light.

name.description: Only entities whose name or id contains this text, e.g. kitchen.

function.name: ha_get_state
function.description: Read one entity's current state and attributes from Home Assistant.

function.name: media_search
function.description: Search the media library. Takes several seconds to return.

acknowledgement.description: A few words said aloud while this runs, e.g. "Searching the library." They are spoken for you as it starts; do not also call speak for them.

function.name: remember
function.description: Keep a lasting fact about the person you are speaking with, to recall in later conversations. Use it when they ask you to remember something, or tell you a preference that will still hold tomorrow.

fact.description: The fact, as one plain sentence that makes sense on its own later, e.g. Takes oat milk in coffee.

shareable.description: True only when they say the rest of the household may know it.

function.name: speak
function.description: Say something to the user. Runs concurrently with other tools; the model chooses when and whether to speak.

mode.description: queue appends after current speech; preempt cancels it; interject ducks and cuts in.
